newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian housing firm doubles profits.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian housing firm doubles profits.

text.p: Egyptian housing company Development and Popular Houses made net after-tax profits of 12.003 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, 114 percent up on 5.6 million in 1994/5, according to audited results available on Sunday. The years end on June 30.
Turnover fell to 52.541 million pounds, 7.4 percent down on 56.723 million in the previous year, but profits before tax were 13.351 million, 100 percent up on 6.677 million.
The state sold the private sector more than 70 percent of the company's 3.5 million shares this month at 29.00 pounds a share. The shares have not traded since September 5.
